newsitem.title: USA: Lucent declines comment on Kazakhstan suit.
newsitem.headline: Lucent declines comment on Kazakhstan suit.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc declined to comment immediately on a lawsuit filed by a joint venture partner in a scuttled project in Kazakhstan.
"We have just been served," a Lucent spokesman said. "We are still reviewing (the complaint) so we can't comment on it."

AT&T, which was also named with Lucent as a defendant in the complaint as the former parent of Lucent, referred calls to Lucent, which inherited the network operations unit that is the subject of the lawsuit.

Telecom 21 LLC and Telecom 21 Ventures LLC said Monday they filed suit against AT&T and Lucent in a Dallas state court, alleging fraud and breach of fiduciary duties over a scuttled project in Kazakhstan.
The project involved converting a former Soviet nuclear missile site in Kazakhstan into a civilian telecommunications teleport.
The plaintiffs said AT&T had made financial projections for a 10-year period placing the value of the project at "well over $6 billion" at the end of the period.
